steps.name: Army recapturing the Temple of Ceres
steps.objective:
“Temple of Ceres” can be accessed through “Banaheim”!
Go to [Eileen] at the “Recapture Army Temporary Garrison”.

steps.name: Hey, a letter of recommendation... .
steps.objective: After talking with [Eileen], go to “Guild Union” and report to [Einst].

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Stop! You can't go in without an entry permit!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have anything like that... .

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: It is a place that no one can enter. Registration of the recapture force is still required. It doesn't look like an enemy, but you still need to check.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: If you have a letter of recommendation or a certificate proving that you are a member of the temple, please show it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry. How could it not?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: What brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for someone. I heard that they went from Ribera to where the Temple of Ceres is. The name is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: We have a lot of work to do. I don't have time to talk at length with someone without proof of identity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: We ask that you receive a branded letter of recommendation from someone we know by name and someone we can trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who can I prove... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those who know are too far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, do you know anyone in the guild union? What about Einst?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Are you Einst? Yes, then if you bring his letter of recommendation, I will acknowledge it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I'll be back soon.

steps.name: Joining process completed
steps.objective: After talking with [Einst], go to the “Recapture Army Temporary Garrison” and report to [Eileen].

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (As soon as Einst hears %s's story, he looks at him with a puzzled expression.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It's been a while since I was wondering what was going on, and I was told that I needed a letter of recommendation to go to the Temple of Ceres. It's a bit complicated there now. Demons appeared and attacked the temple.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: So, members of the guild association associated with the temple rushed there. First, I want to hear your story. Why did you go to the temple of Ceres?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It tells you what happened so far.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Is that so? The girl you were looking for went to the temple to meet Ceres? But where did it appear like that?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There hasn't been any news yet? It's surprising that it's a temple. Since I have to meet Ceres, I wonder if I will ever be able to meet the legendary goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I don't know anything, I'd like to ask for a letter of recommendation.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Okay, I have to go there first, so I'll write you a letter of recommendation first.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I think it would be advantageous if you joined... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not that skilled yet... .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Haven't you already solved several problems?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Maybe you can find what you want there. So don't lose confidence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: However, in order to do that, I may have to help the recapture army.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: If you come in looking for someone in these turbulent times, there is nothing you can do to gain their trust.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Well, here's the recommendation, check it out.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Einst created the letter, stamped it, and handed it over.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Be sure to keep in mind what I said earlier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. All right.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh, and as your reputation grows, there will be people who will try to take advantage of you. I'm saying this because I think you like people and can't say no.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You know what I mean, right?

steps.name: terms and conditions
steps.objective: After talking with [Eileen], report to [Tigris] at the “Recapture Army Temporary Garrison.”

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: You have received a letter of recommendation from Einst.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Let's check it out in a moment.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: (Aileen, who was reading the recommendation letter, reads it with concentration and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is that?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: There's no problem, but you've solved a lot of problems so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: I was a little surprised by how much more activity I did than I expected. He came from another continent to help the guild union... . You have quite a bit of history.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I somehow ended up like that.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Hmm, let me take a look again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please do so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mr. Einst wrote a lot in the letter of recommendation….)

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: He told me to trust him and leave it to him as it would be a tremendous amount of power... . Hmm, full power... . I didn't intend to entrust you with the battle, but I will report to Tigris in a moment.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: It is said that it is no problem for him to survive among many enemies and carry out his mission... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How long should I wait?

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Oh, the permit just came out. If you join us, we will provide generous support.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: We welcome you to join us and look forward to your great performance.

lines.speaker: 에일린
lines.text: Commander Tigris is in the center of the garrison, so go to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

steps.name: Pretus
steps.objective: Go to the “Temple of Ceres Road” and kill the [Imp Search Party] and [Blue Swamp Tribe Assault Unit]. Then, go to “Inside the Temple of Ceres” and report to [Pretus].

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: (Tigris reads Einst’s letter of recommendation and looks at %s’s face again.)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Oh my goodness, I get to see all of Einst’s letters of recommendation. It's surprising that someone who doesn't often praise someone praises him.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It seems like you've been through a lot so far, wasn't it difficult?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot of things happened, but I'm okay now. Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: I heard that you played a big role in the last Yongje Castle incident. What on earth happened there? .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: As far as I know, most of the enemies were regular troops from Yongje Province, which ruled the world in the past. Were they human? or not… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's hard to say... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's okay, you don't have to tell me everything.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Anyway, what is the biggest reason you came here? In your eyes, it doesn't seem like you're chasing fame or fortune.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for a girl named Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He briefly explains the process, saying he came here to find Iris.)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Thank goodness. You came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: I'm saying it's not a mistake.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: We were with Iris not long ago. He is the one you are looking for. Iris You knew. I know you're coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Yeah. It is protected by the elites of our temple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you are protecting Iris, but why are there elites attached? Other temple people will also need protection... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: He is the recipient of an oracle. Let me just say this for now.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Now, I will trust you with your history, so please lend us your strength. For Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: There is a paladin named Fretus inside the temple, so meet him first and hear about the enemies inside.

steps.name: Cleaning up the interior of the temple
steps.objective: Defeat the [Succubus Wizard], [Butterfly Rider Seeker], and [Elite Satyr Fighter] located “inside the Temple of Ceres”.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Who is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you Fretus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tigris sent me here.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Are you here to stop me? But I can't go back like this. He deserves to die for not being able to complete his duties as the church's gatekeeper.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Please tell Tigris that even if he cares for me, I can't help it. Please come back quickly. It's dangerous here.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: This is not a place for just anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's it. I am trying to infiltrate there at the request of Tigris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tigris asked Fretus to listen to the story about the enemy within.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You mean Dragon Newt?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that a dragon newt?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You came here without knowing anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So can you tell us about the situation here now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know the situation to some extent, but I think it would be good to hear from Fretus.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: The commander sent me, so I will tell you. The temple was attacked by a demonic force led by 'Dragon Newt', one of the demonic clans.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Newt, a dragon named Blas, is called the corps commander and commands the demons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, keep talking.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: It seems that the reason they came here was because of Lux, the so-called lord of the demon world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux… .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You know that name. Then you… . The Dragon Lord Castle on the Gendia continent, where the matter of Drullizi and Rivera has been resolved... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… ? How... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: The information coming to the temple also included a story about you. Of course, there was that incident too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demon Lord Lux and Agashura... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Anyway, let me tell you about the situation at the temple.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Among the demons that attacked the temple, most of the troops left and only Blas's army remained. It looks like he's looking for something.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Whatever it is, I cannot forgive demons and demons.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Because so many people have been wronged, I can never, ever leave here, even for their sake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fretus, do you know what the demons are looking for?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I don't know much about that either.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Sorry. Because I don’t know anything… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything important left here?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: They took all the objects and records containing the power of Goddess Ceres.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Originally, the records of Goddess Ceres were supposed to be left in Giandia, but at some point they ended up also being left in Freios.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Perhaps another god wanted to make Goddess Ceres' words known.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: First, we need to clear out the demons here. If any remaining survivors encounter them... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I don't even want to imagine it. Please help me. No, this is also for God.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: God... . Ah, yes. Then we'll do something. I'll be back.

steps.name: 1st Corps Commander Blas
steps.objective: Go to the “Holy Synagogue” and defeat [Blas] and talk to him.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: … It's amazing. You really have amazing skills. I was truly impressed.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: It may be just my greed, but I want to ask them to continue working for the temple... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: That would be impossible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I have work to do... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: It's okay to refuse. Now, how about taking a slightly closer approach? If it's Adventurer, I think you can deal with him.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Blass… .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Only by defeating him, who is leading the demon army, will the temple be able to think about the next step. Please Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It may be risky, but I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Yes, I thought Adventurer would give you that answer. I'm sure you can deal with it well enough.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I ask you to subdue Blas as soon as you find him and find out why he is here.

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk… . How long has it been since you received such a strong attack? That too in humans... .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: I lost. I admit defeat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some demons say they can't admit their defeat and make all kinds of vile excuses... .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: I’m not interested… .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: It looks like there's a lot you want to know from me. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Looking at those eyes reminds me of a boy from a long time ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about, but I hope you answer me

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you attack the temple? If you were really going to attack, you should have done it before. Why now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what were you looking for by staying here?

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: I have a lot of questions. There is nothing I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer me… . hurry… . If you don't answer, I will... .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Wow, it's funny that you're hesitating. Adventurer, there's a smell all around you. To say that this is the smell of blood from those who were harmed by you... .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Kill me, stop acting hypocritical like other humans. Otherwise, I will kill you right now... .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: Damn it. I don't even have the strength left to kill you. I would just die for Lux. I will not betray you!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly is Lux to you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll think about your disposition, so tell me what you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's good information, you... . Now, wait… .

lines.speaker: 블라스
lines.text: (Blas grins in pain and gradually disappears. It seems that he chose to disappear instead of providing information about Lux.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, what are you doing? Buy, don’t disappear!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to somehow survive and get information... .

steps.name: Why did they take control of the Temple of Ceres?
steps.objective: After defeating [Baphomet] in the “Holy Synagogue”, find out the purpose of the Lux Legion’s presence at the temple.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: A devil who chooses his own extinction... . I thought there would be no loyalty or loyalty since they are demons, but I was wrong.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do now? There isn't much information... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Just a moment, just a moment. Let’s think about numbers for a moment.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Ah, it seems like another entity still remains in the temple... . It is a demon called Baphomet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baphomet? Why is he still around?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: He is Blas' henchman. They may still be unable to escape and remain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if that demon also chooses to disappear on its own?

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I've encountered it once, but I don't think so.  I feel like I came here reluctantly, so I will definitely be looking for a way to survive.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Demons instinctively recognize those who have dealt with those stronger than themselves. Adventurer will notice right away when you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then I'll go and meet Baphomet and talk to him.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: … I couldn't believe I dealt with Blas... . Really... .

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: What on earth are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just human.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: I haven't seen many people with this kind of skill. What kind of person are you... .

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: No way… . Who sent it?

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: Did Lux send you? Or other demonic powers... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, tell me.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: What are you going to do if you don't tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you came here reluctantly. So answer appropriately and step aside appropriately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because we don't want much from you.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: Are you really going to save me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, if you tell me everything you know, I'll ask for leniency.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you attack the temple?

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: It is power. Lux needed the power of a god. It's obvious. I want to take control of this world. So I am looking for the power of the gods of this world.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: You are trying to obtain everything that is intertwined with the power of God. In particular, the temple of Ceres is where a lot of that power remains.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Ceres, the star god, probably doesn't know that she disappeared a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: I'm not sure about that, but I heard there's a similar force here.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: We tried to find the person with that power and bring him to Lux. Then our mission was over... .

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: In the end I couldn't find it. I guess God had no intention of giving us strength.

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: This much I know. It's true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Similar power exists here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And don't show up here again. Promise me just one thing. Otherwise… .

lines.speaker: 바포메트
lines.text: (As soon as he finishes speaking, Baphomet runs away without even looking back.)

steps.name: Transaction completed?
steps.objective: Report to [Tigris] at the “Recapture Army Temporary Garrison”.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: You are here. Was it successful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: (Pretus, who received the conversation with Baphomet, looks on with a surprised expression.)

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: I see. Perhaps the oracle, the oracle left by the goddess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now let’s talk about trusts.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Sorry. I can't tell you based on my level. Please find Tigris and tell him what you have solved so far.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Adventurer will then tell you what you want to know. Thank you again. As I clean up this place, I will look for more survivors.

lines.speaker: 프레투스
lines.text: Hey Adventurer… . Ah, there you go. He looked disappointed... .

steps.name: Those who met Iris
steps.objective: Talk to Battle Lord [Leo] at the “Recapture Army Temporary Garrison”.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: To immediately get rid of the person we had been struggling with... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: As expected, Adventurer has great skills as I heard!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, please tell me. You must keep your promise.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You seem angry for some reason. As promised, why is Iris here, and where are you after the temple attack... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can we finally meet Iris….)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Iris came here a year ago. The person who went missing after fighting the devil came here via Rivera. Ceres said she saved me and I had to meet her... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: We were waiting for Iris to come. Before that, an oracle was given to protect Iris. I can't say what kind of god it is, but Iris came and I was able to believe in it.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: In the meantime, we protected Iris and did not inform any outside members. I'm sorry about that. It’s such an important matter… .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: In the meantime, Iris fell asleep and did not wake up for a long time. Then, suddenly, the troops of Lux, the Demon Lord, attacked.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: We've assigned Iris our best escort to get you far away. What they wanted was clearly the power of God... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: That's when we found out. Why did the trust ask me to protect Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux's goal was to rule the world based on Ceres' power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means that the power... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: What you think is correct. We did not just protect a girl, we protected a goddess with a new destiny.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: These are things that neither the listener nor the speaker can believe.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Iris The reason you came here on time was probably due to Ceres' guidance. It seems Ceres passed on the power of the temple while Iris was asleep.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Iris That is why you were chosen as a god to succeed Ceres in human form.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Iris You are in very dangerous condition. There are many people seeking that power. So I had no choice but to attach an escort and get them out of this place.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: I can't believe it, but I heard from Iris that you experienced another world. It's called Yggdrasil... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: For now, it seems like Velosh has temporarily solved that problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Velosh, who is that?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: One of the three Demigods... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was that something a demigod could solve?

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: They say they solved it, so I have no choice but to believe it. He is a great demigod of our temple.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: So don't doubt it. Iris I am the one helping you, so trust me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is strange...)

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Demigods chase light and destroy darkness with the power they received from the ancient gods. Everything else is achieved through experience and effort.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: You don't know, but many places, including the temple, have suffered ominous attacks. The reason I was able to survive at that time was all thanks to this Demigod.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: So, I have no choice but to trust the person who escorts and serves Iris... ..

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: If you still have doubts, there's nothing you can do about it. Velosh is also suspicious of you.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Iris asked me to wait so I could meet you, but I said I didn't have time and asked to go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm a little late... .

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: It's okay. are you okay. When the time comes, you will be able to meet Iris. Because Iris is looking forward to it too.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Right now, Iris will be following the Demigod to a safe place. Let’s hear from Leo for more details.

lines.speaker: 티그리스
lines.text: Has it already gone? I was going to say thank you one more time... .

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Iris? As Tigris said, with Demigod… . Okay, okay. Where exactly is he going to the Eastern Continent?

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Why are you surprised?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Eastern Continent? Where is the Eastern Continent?

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: It's a special continent to the east of Freios. I heard that one of them went to the great sword god Jiscard.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: That was the place that Frozen thought of as a safe place while escorting Iris. A long time ago, when Frozen went to Eastland for work, he said he had a connection.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Jiscard must have given permission and went.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did you move there? Is it really okay to trust it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Okay, okay. As I heard, I heard that someone was coming to see Iris, but I never thought it was true.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Right now Iris is incomplete. Please know that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: The process of becoming a god in a human body will never be easy. Now, demons have been attacking us because of that power... .

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Iris would do well on that... . I don't know how long it will take to get it perfect.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: So we need help from many people now.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Iris There must be more than one enemy targeting you... .

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Are you still going to see Iris? One day you may have to deal with all of those enemies.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: I'd like to hear an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So please tell me how to get to where Iris is.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: (As expected, he is different from a typical person. Just as Iris said….)

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I thought about something else for a moment.

lines.speaker: 레오
lines.text: Okay, okay. Just wait a moment. I'll let you get there as soon as you're ready.
